scope: Bounded source-only review of the per-user settings layout patch; no compilation or visual/native acceptance performed by reviewer.
findings_resolved: A single Page::User dispatch calls user_settings before the generic outer vertical ScrollArea, allowing the bottom Apply/error footer to remain in the finite page viewport.
The nine tab labels, original tab mapping, per-button Script.observe and consume_action guards are retained.
The Apply candidate is validated after tab edits are saved to the seat; name editing and Remove this user retain stopped-session guards.
The horizontal tab scroller uses pinned egui 0.34.3 Spacing.scroll.bar_width; footer height uses public Ouroboros core::Size::Md.height matching Button::new default size.
Patch application proof reconstructs the draft exactly; App::logic bytes remain unchanged.
limits: Source review only; no visual pixel approval at minimum window size.
No native lifecycle, device, or runtime acceptance is claimed.
producer_status_at_review: Formatting, strict Clippy, 135 workspace tests, and x64 build passed; i686 build was still running.
